C0105.title: Botspot++: A Hierarchical Deep Ensemble Model for Bots Install Fraud Detection in Mobile Advertising
C0105.summary: This study proposes Botspot++, a hierarchical deep ensemble model for detecting bot-driven install fraud in mobile advertising.
